initialExam.title: ESIC Staff Nurse / Paramedical 2026
initialExam.description: ESIC recruits Staff Nurses and paramedical staff for ESI hospitals and dispensaries across India.
initialExam.eligibility: B.Sc Nursing / GNM Diploma, registered with Nursing Council
initialExam.syllabus: Nursing subjects, General Awareness, English, Reasoning.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Document Verification → Medical → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Staff Nurse / Paramedical staff in ESIC hospitals
initialExam.careerGrowth: Staff Nurse → Nursing Superintendent → Asst. Director (Nursing).
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit esic.nic.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, NPA, Medical, Pension, Uniform allowance
